title: 1.2 People in Action
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Use el and la with each person, then say what one person is doing with está and an -ando/-iendo action.
grammar_function: El/La + person + está + action; Él/Ella está + action; es (who) vs está (doing).
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1: un, una, the four people, él, ella, and es.
speaking_outcome: Say what one person is doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: el: the boy gets his article.
está + comiendo: what he is doing right now.
El niño + está comiendo.
